subject: MATHEMATICS
title: The 100-Place Parade
objective: Identify ordinal positions through 100th from a stated start and direction.
introduction: Ordinal numbers show position, and the starting point and direction must be clear. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: A symbol or word that tells how many.
An exact spot in space, marked with a dot.
A straight mark that goes on and on.
